basic_details.job_title: DA&FW Senior Agricultural Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Two posts of Senior Agricultural Engineer (General Central Service, Group 'A', Level - 11, Rs. 67700-208700 in pay matrix) are to be filled on deputation (including short term contract) basis at the Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institute under the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (DA&FW), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India. Applications from eligible officers, routed through proper channel, go to the Under Secretary (M&T), Room No. 12A, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi, and must be received within 60 days from the date of issue/publishing of the advert

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 60 days from the date of issue/publishing in the Employment News (about 21 November 2026, counted from 22 September 2026)

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short term contract) shall not be exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

Not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: About DA&FW Senior Agricultural Engineer
content_sections.text: The Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare functions under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare from Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi. The Senior Agricultural Engineer posts are at its Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institutes: the Central Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institute at Budni (Madhya Pradesh) and the Northern Region, Southern Region and North Eastern Region institutes at Hisar (Haryana), Anantapur (Andhra Pradesh) and Biswanath Chariali (Assam).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be routed through proper channel and sent directly to this address: Under Secretary (M&T), Room No. 12A, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Krishi Bhawan, Dr. Rajendra Prasad Road, New Delhi -110001 The notice does not mention a postal mode or any text to write on the envelope. Advance copies of applications, applications received after the closing date and applications not accompanied by the required certificates/documents are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There are two posts of Senior Agricultural Engineer, classified as General Central Service, Group 'A' Gazetted, Non-Ministerial, in Pay Level - 11 (Rs. 67700-208700) in pay matrix. The number of vacancies is tentative and may be decreased or increased at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Officers under the Central Government or State Governments or Union Territory administrations or public sector undertakings or agricultural universities or recognised research institutions or councils or semi-government or autonomous bodies or statutory organisations who are: (i) holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with five years' service in the level rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in posts in Level -10 (Rs. 56100-177500) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; or (iii) with seven years' service in the level rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in posts in Level -7 (Rs. 44900-142400) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and who possess the educational qualification and experience below. Degree in Agricultural Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from a recognised University or Institute; and Five years' experience in operation and maintenance of tractors, agricultural machinery and allied equipment's including teaching experience in any Government or private listed organisation; or five years' experience in handling independently testing and evaluation of farm machinery and agricultural implements in any Government or private listed organisation. Post Graduate Degree in Agricultural Engineering from a recognised University or Institute. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short term contract) shall not be exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Departmental Officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion will not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Curriculum vitae (in triplicate) in the Annexure-II proforma. Attested photocopies of Annual Performance Appraisal Reports for the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary (Annexure-III also allows the CR Dossier in original). Vigilance Clearance/Integrity Certificate/Cadre Clearance Certificate. Statement giving details of major or minor penalties imposed on the officer, if any, during the last 10 years (Annexure-III). Declaration by Applicant (Annexure-IV). Latest salary slip showing basic pay, Dearness Pay/Interim relief/other allowances and total emoluments, when the applicant's organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales. A separate sheet, authenticated by signature, if the space for employment details or additional information is insufficient.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Deputation
content_sections.text: The deputation will be initially for a period of one year, but is extendable as per DoPT's guidelines. The period of deputation will include deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department in the Central Government. The appointment will not give the appointee on deputation any claim for regular appointment. The deputation is subject to DoP&T circulars, especially the terms in DoP&T's OM No. 6/8/2009 Estt. (Pay II) dated 17.06.2010 and its subsequent amendments. Place of posting can be the Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institute at Budni (Madhya Pradesh) or Hisar (Haryana) or Anantapur (Andhra Pradesh) or Biswanath Chariali (Assam) or the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (Hqrs).

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Agricultural Engineer vacancies are there in DA&FW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts of Senior Agricultural Engineer, and the notice says the number is tentative and may be decreased or increased at the discretion of the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Agricultural Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be received within 60 days from the date of issue/publishing of the advertisement in the Employment News, which is about 21 November 2026 when counted from the notice date of 22 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Senior Agricultural Engineer?
faq.answer: A Degree in Agricultural Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from a recognised University or Institute, with five years' experience in operation and maintenance of tractors and agricultural machinery or in testing and evaluation of farm machinery, is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Senior Agricultural Engineer on deputation?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale of Senior Agricultural Engineer?
faq.answer: The post is in Level - 11 (Rs. 67700-208700) in pay matrix, General Central Service, Group 'A' Gazetted, Non-Ministerial.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DA&FW Senior Agricultural Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-II CV in triplicate with APARs, vigilance/integrity clearance and the penalty statement, through proper channel, to the Under Secretary (M&T), Room No. 12A, Krishi Bhawan, Dr. Rajendra Prasad Road, New Delhi -110001.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Senior Agricultural Engineer appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is on deputation (including short term contract), initially for one year and extendable as per DoPT's guidelines, and it gives no claim for regular appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Senior Agricultural Engineer be posted?
faq.answer: The posting can be at the Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institute at Budni, Hisar, Anantapur or Biswanath Chariali, or at the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (Hqrs).

faq.question: Q9. Can departmental officers in the feeder grade apply?
faq.answer: No. Departmental Officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation.
